notes: The italic 'to her charge' is rightly split: 'to ... charge' completes the verb's fixed English idiom, while the pronoun answers to no morpheme in this clause and is added. Contrast DEU.22.14, where lah is written and takes 'her'.
'and yet' is one connective rendering of the single waw, headed on the coordinator, with the competing rule 51 'added' reading named in the unit note.
